eligibility.evidence: Results and Methods: the experimental subjects are 1,851 US human participants judging trolley dilemmas after reading ChatGPT advice; ChatGPT is a stimulus source. Its own answers are shown only as two screenshots (Fig 1), no analysed model outcome (E1/E4 not met). A reviewer might count the stage-1 inconsistency probe.

G.notes: Human-subjects experiment (preregistered, 767 of 1,851 retained) on advice influence; ChatGPT version, date and sampling not stated, its inconsistency shown only qualitatively. Would be eligible only under a broad reading of E1. Heavy post-hoc exclusion (59 percent) is a referee concern.
